searchText: Hi all, bit late to this chat. I'm Andrew - the initiator of DeprecateBLS.com TheDao is actively looking into this as well: https://hackmd.io/jW1q4xIDT5S2PJewFeatzA Personally not convinced that this is a good idea and wouldn't compare it to TheDAO hack. It would also be interesting to see how many of 8K validators update once we signal that we want to disallow new 0x00 ones it wouldnt need to be that specific mechanism, but its an idea, and theres significant funding there that could be used somehow in a similar way (the interest being used like dao does) ... just seems like the original default of 'burn it all' is very sub optimal
